description: This file defines the interface FinancialActivityAccountWritePlatformService related to financial activity account operations such as create, update, and delete mappings within the accounting module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for creating, updating, and deleting financial activity account mappings.

methods.name: createFinancialActivityAccountMapping
methods.description: Creates a new financial activity account mapping using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateGLAccountActivityMapping
methods.description: Updates an existing GL account activity mapping identified by mappingId with data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteGLAccountActivityMapping
methods.description: Deletes the GL account activity mapping identified by mappingId.
